all.effect_identity: parent effect id plus the deterministic seed-local, seed-host, push-kv, reseed-azure, and verify child effect ids
all.prepare: Persist the complete ordered child graph and all resolved resource identities before the first mutation.
all.reconciliation: Reconcile each child independently and continue only from the first NOT_APPLIED child; any INDETERMINATE child keeps the parent INDETERMINATE and prevents a duplicate write.

mint.reconciliation: Replay-safe; emits the fixed mint instructions and performs no credential read or mutation.

push-kv.effect_identity: resolved vault resource id plus fixed secret names plus source credential/config fingerprints
push-kv.prepare: Persist the vault resource id, fixed secret names, source fingerprints, and pre-write secret version ids before upload.
push-kv.reconciliation: Key Vault metadata tags bind each new version to effect_id and the non-secret source fingerprint. Matching enabled versions are ALREADY_APPLIED; unchanged pre-write versions are NOT_APPLIED; divergent or partially updated secret versions are INDETERMINATE.

reseed-azure.effect_identity: resolved deployment id plus authenticated reseed request id plus expected Key Vault version ids
reseed-azure.prepare: Persist deployment id, request id, and expected vault versions before the authenticated reseed call.
reseed-azure.reconciliation: Query the authenticated reseed/status surfaces. A receipt for request id followed by remote Claude status valid and a credential file version at least the expected vault version is ALREADY_APPLIED; explicit absence with the old remote version is NOT_APPLIED; timeout without queryable receipt or conflicting versions is INDETERMINATE.

seed-host.effect_identity: host credential provider slot plus source credential fingerprint plus operating-system target kind
seed-host.prepare: Persist the provider slot id, OS target kind, and non-secret source fingerprint before mutation.
seed-host.reconciliation: The provider compares the installed credential fingerprint and runs the bounded exact host AUTH_OK probe. Match plus pass is ALREADY_APPLIED; proved prior fingerprint is NOT_APPLIED; disagreement or an unreadable post-write slot is INDETERMINATE.

seed-local.effect_identity: resolved container id plus fixed credential path plus source credential fingerprint plus optional config fingerprint
seed-local.prepare: Persist the resolved container identity and non-secret source fingerprints before any copy.
seed-local.reconciliation: Hash the installed credential/config inside the same container and run the bounded exact AUTH_OK probe. Matching fingerprints and a passing probe are ALREADY_APPLIED; proved old fingerprints are NOT_APPLIED; a replaced container, partial fingerprint match, or conflicting target is INDETERMINATE.

status.reconciliation: Replay the typed local, host, and vault status probes; absence is an explicit observed state, never a skipped success.

verify.reconciliation: Replay every selected bounded probe and retain its typed result; no selected target may be silently skipped.

policy.dry_run_rule: dry_run=true performs no credential read or mutation and terminalizes only as DRY_RUN, never APPLIED.
policy.secret_rule: Credential contents never enter argv, logs, journal events, terminal artifacts, or error text. The owner may retain only a non-secret content SHA-256 and provider/resource version identifiers.

command_specific.all: Every required child effect is semantically successful in order, remote Claude verification passes, temporary secret material owned by the effect is deleted, and the parent emits one terminal event.
command_specific.mint: The fixed operator instructions are emitted and no credential source was accessed.
command_specific.push-kv: The credential secret version and, when supplied, config secret version exist, are enabled, carry this effect id, and match the non-secret source fingerprints; config absence is explicit when no config was supplied.
command_specific.reseed-azure: The authenticated reseed receipt matches request id and remote Claude credential status is valid with the expected source version; generic HTTP health is insufficient.
command_specific.seed-host: The installed host credential fingerprint matches the prepared source and the exact host Claude probe returns AUTH_OK within 60 seconds.
command_specific.seed-local: Installed fingerprints match the prepared sources in the resolved container and its exact Claude probe returns AUTH_OK within 60 seconds.
command_specific.status: Typed observations exist for every requested/required status surface, including explicit PRESENT, ABSENT, VALID, INVALID, UNREACHABLE, or NOT_CONFIGURED states; success means the report is complete, not that credentials are valid.
command_specific.verify: Every selected target returns its exact semantic pass marker; a missing CLI, stopped container, unreachable remote, or skipped probe fails verification.

common: The process return code is zero.
A schema-valid non-secret terminal artifact names command, effect_id, verdict, resolved resource ids, observation/result codes, and child effect ids where applicable.
Every command-required semantic condition passes; warning or skipped output cannot satisfy a required condition.
Exactly one owner_terminal event and one matching terminal artifact exist for effect_id.
source_corrections: Replace eval-based command construction with typed argv/provider calls after schema validation.
Do not suppress reseed request failures or accept generic /health output as Claude credential success.
Do not let missing host/container/remote targets silently pass when that target is required.
Emit a structured non-secret terminal artifact instead of relying on colored human-readable markers.
